name: Fine noodles with grilled pork
summary: Bánh hỏi thịt nướng is sheets of fine rice noodle, soft and lightly oiled, eaten with charcoal-grilled pork. Scallion fat, crushed peanut, and sweet-sour fish sauce finish the plate.
origin: A Mekong noodle sheet, eaten in Châu Đốc with grilled pork.
texture: The sheets are loose and soft. A thin film of oil keeps them from tasting of raw flour.
howToEat: Lay the grilled pork on the sheets, with scallion fat and crushed peanut on top.
Pour the sweet-sour fish sauce over the plate, or dip. Some stalls add chả giò and chả cá.
seoTitle: Banh hoi thit nuong in Chau Doc
seoDescription: Bánh hỏi thịt nướng in Châu Đốc is soft fine rice-noodle sheets with charcoal-grilled pork, scallion fat, peanut, and sweet-sour fish sauce.
